decision_basis: The official Cosmos3-Nano positive control passed, proving the pinned deployment could produce dynamic forward predictions, but the frozen DROID action-conditioning pathway failed the causal and rollout-reliability gates in one underpowered session. Blueprint correctly abstained. No valid whole-stack closed-loop ranking, independently anchored captured-site transfer, or useful end-to-end physical economics comparison was completed.

cosmos_wam_qualification.basis: The NVIDIA AgiBotWorld positive control passed 3/4 frozen motion gates. On the frozen DROID matrix, native Cosmos passed 1/10 active scene-response comparisons, 2/10 temporal-placebo comparisons, and 0/5 both-seed robustness conditions. The tier-1 gate found five static-under-command failures and session-median timing correlation 0.022880 versus 0.15 required. One independent session is below the prospective 17-session target.

frozen_benchmark_calibration.basis: Across 63 sessions, seven policies, and 441 episodes, GPT-5 mini achieved Spearman 0.357143, Kendall tau-b 0.238095, policy pairwise accuracy 0.619048 with clustered interval [0.428571, 0.857143], selective coverage 0.050182, and selective pairwise accuracy 0.600000. Gemini 3.6 Flash achieved 0.75, 0.619048, and 0.809524 respectively, but only after label unseal and with zero abstentions.

captured_site_transfer.basis: Phase C was not admitted. No Blueprint 3DGS/site adapter was run through this frozen stack and no independently attributable physical outcomes existed for the same site, task, embodiment, and policies.

economics_and_speed.basis: Attributable digital costs were measured, but no WAM arm completed a useful ranking and no defensible physical monetary or robot-hour baseline was available. No speed ratio, cost ratio, or break-even policy count is claimed.

phase_b.claim_ceiling: open-loop deployment and DROID causal diagnostics with correct product abstention only

wam_arms.historical_oscar: Experiment 2 remains thesis_not_supported for its frozen OSCAR-derived stack.
wam_arms.skeleton_only_new_phase_b: not run because required camera calibration was unavailable
wam_arms.native_cosmos: official positive control passed; frozen DROID causal and reliability screens failed
wam_arms.cosmos_oscar_skeleton_hybrid: not run; no hybrid result claimed

cheapest_scientifically_valid_next_exper: Complete the exact upstream Cosmos3 DROID normalization and preprocessing audit. If ambiguity remains, run the preregistered label-free action-scale dose-response diagnostic, freeze any selected transform, then use new untouched independent DROID sessions for a powered causal confirmation before full-episode ranking.
